text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"To my darling Big Bro. I have something

important to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"To my darling Big Sis. I have something

important to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Please see my next message for details.
I'll be
waiting for you at 11 a.m.
tomorrow. –Curren"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This message comes in the night with no
warning.
It has a sense of unusual
gravitas... I wonder if she
wants to talk
about senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No, this is Curren Chan we're talking
about. It
might not have anything to do
with racing at all.
Unsure how to feel, I
go to meet her the next
day...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming, Big Bro. I said I
have
something important to tell you, so
let's just get
right to it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming, Big Sis. I said I
have
something important to tell you, so
let's just get
right to it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I've figured out who my senior-year rivals
will
most likely be, so I'd like to report
them to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's demeanor is much more
serious
than usual. Understanding the
need to be
professional and pay close
attention, I sit up
straight.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okay, here's the information I gathered.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let me know right away if anything
catches your
attention, 'kay? Here it
goes...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let me know right away if anything
catches your
attention, 'kay? Here it
goes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan places what looks like her
personal
tablet on the table and plays a
video she seems
to have edited herself.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Hyaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"With the flame of justice in my heart, I
rush to
the scene to destroy any and all
evil! I am... Biko
Pegasus!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's Biko Pegasus. From what I've
gathered,
she's thinking about running in
next year's
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I'll be up against her
soon. Not
only that, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, everybody! Let's have a good
time and..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Look out for more of my Umatoks!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Biko's big on UmaTok. She makes
short
videos heavily inspired by
superhero shows, so
kids and superhero
fans are really into her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I guess you could call her a superhero
UmaToker.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "...Is it recording? Oh!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Every day is buono! The bigger and
tastier, the
better. ♪ I'm Hishi
Akebonooo! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's Hishi Akebono. She's my friend
and a really
good cook. She uses that
skill to...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I got a request to make a cake with
cute flowers
on it, so on today's
Umastagram Live, that's just
what I'm
gonna do! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
She's cute and tall but also uploads
videos of her
making delicately designed
cakes and other
dishes. She's a huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Flower, who I ran with before,
specializes in
lunches, but Akebono
doesn't box herself into to
a single
genre.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
She helped pioneer the food
Umastagrammer
trend. Next up is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Got it! And... pause!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: What's up?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I thought I told you before, these are my
future
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She did say that... but it just looks like
she's
showing me all the Umamusume at
Tracen
Academy who are popular on
social media.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, if that's all, I'm gonna press
play. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Howdy, y'all! It's me, Taiki Shuttle!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's Taiki Shuttle. She's a super
cheerful daily
vlogger on UmaTube.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I'm fixin' to have a good ol'
fashioned
barbeque!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"My folks sent me a buncha giiinormous
steaks,
and we got a beeea-utiful blue
sky today, so I
reckon it's time to fire up
the grill!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
She's got a huge personality, she's
dynamic, and
she uploads, like, her
entire life onto UmaTube.
Everyone
loves her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Taiiikiii! How many times must I tell you
not to
grill on school grounds?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Well, if it isn't our first guest! Y'all know
her
already—it's Air Groove!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Don't make me your guest!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"So, uhhh... Don't! Break! Academy!
Rules!
M'kay?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"BOOM! Posted! AH-HAHAHA!
Perfection!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I really am the best class representative!
I never
get tired of the day-to-day of
class rep life..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "I mean, I'm posting academy rules to Umatter every day! Go me! I'm awesome! The incredible class rep!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
She basically explained it already, but
that's the
Sakura Bakushin O, the class
representative.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, a notification already! Maybe it's
a student
complimenting me on a job
well done!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "WHAT?! My post says "do break academy rules"?! I posted the wrong thing?!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O is getting big on
Umatter
because of all her random posts
and the terrifying
amount of typos they
contain.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's about it. Those are my
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I think my biggest competition is
Akebono since
she's an Umastagrammer
too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Uh, Big Bro?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Uh, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? You haven't realized?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? You haven't realized?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Come on. Even after seeing them all
lined up like
this... you didn't notice
anything?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus, Hishi Akebono, Taiki
Shuttle, and
Sakura Bakushin O. The
thing they all have in
common is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's right! ♪
choice_data_list_en: All of them are on the sprint route!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's super convenient for me, don't you
think? The
stars of Umastagram,
Umatter, and UmaTok are
all sprinters!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Throw me into the mix and we might
even be able
to get more attention than
the Derby or the
Tenno Sho... or even
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, not just "might." I'm gonna make it
happen!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoever wins the biggest race... will
totally be
the cutest runner. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm taking them all on next year!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm taking them all on next year!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm still ironing out all the details! Just
look
forward to a bunch of fun stuff
senior year. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's planning something...
Today's
events tell me that I need to
prepare myself for
whatever happens.
